name: Dive Deeper into GA4 Data and Reports
description: This collection of learning shows you how to use Google Analytics to answer common business questions.  This course will teach you how to:Use standard and customized reports to answer your business questions and organize the reports for your teamsVisualize your user journeys using various exploration techniquesUse key events to gain insights into the actions that are most important to your businessUse segments to compare how different groups of users interact with your siteTake advantage of connecting Google Ads to Google Analytics to understand and optimize your marketing
